name: zeptap
description: Operate a real iPhone from AI agents: screenshots, OCR, taps, typing, opening apps. Needs the Zeptap Mac app.
long_description:
Zeptap is a Mac app that lets AI agents see and operate a real iPhone. The Mac reads the iPhone screen over USB and sends taps and typing over Bluetooth through AssistiveTouch. Nothing is installed on the iPhone.

This bundle is a small stdio relay that starts the Zeptap app in --stdio mode. It requires the Zeptap app installed in /Applications with an iPhone connected by USB and paired over Bluetooth.

The Mac app is closed source and paid. The first hour of live use is free. See https://zeptap.com/pricing
